body:
To first start off an introduction I've done the usual from cannabis to alcohol to amphetamines to various pills. I first tried Yohimbe because of most of the things I have used, just to see how it affected me and if it really does work.
Well I was disappointed when I saw so many negative reports about Yohimbe because I find if I'm in the mood for extra arousal or any reason to use it, it works every time. I've used it combined with Alcohol too even though it shouldn't be but it still worked and for me didn't have any bad interaction. On average it takes a good hour to kick in fully. I've also smoked Cannabis and used it and of course the Cannabis adds its own aphrodisiac effect so it's a fun and interesting combo.
Anyway in my opinion Yohimbe is a great aphrodisiac.
